def generate_inputs(device):
    # Each channel has constant value -> variance = 0 per channel
    # rsqrt(eps) vs eps creates ~31 million x difference in scale
    x = torch.zeros(16, 64, 256, 256, device=device)
    for c in range(64):
        x[:, c, :, :] = float(c) * 0.1 + 1.0  # Different constant per channel
    return [x]

For BatchNorm implementations, always test BOTH model.train() and model.eval() modes since they use fundamentally different computational kernels. Consider adding automatic detection of training/eval conditional branches in CUDA kernels to ensure both paths receive coverage.
